errors.bot-token-not-configured: Telegram is not connected yet. Connect Telegram in Administration → Integrations first.
errors.tenant-required: Tenant context is required to send a test message.
errors.chat-not-found: Telegram chat was not found. Verify the chat ID and make sure you have started a conversation with the bot.
errors.bot-unauthorized: Telegram rejected the bot token. Verify the token from BotFather.
errors.bot-blocked: The bot was blocked by this chat. Unblock the bot and try again.
errors.bot-cannot-initiate: The bot cannot message this chat until the user starts the bot or adds it to the group.
errors.api-error: Telegram could not send the message. Check bot settings and try again.

dialog.title: Connect Telegram
dialog.instructions:
Click Connect to open the Telegram bot, press Start, and keep this window open while we confirm the connection.

If automatic linking does not work, paste your numeric chat ID below (from @userinfobot) and click Connect.
